learnings: The host Go toolchain was not installed on PATH, so Go compile/test verification was run with the official golang:1.26.5 Docker image.

Specmatic full resiliency found a WIP-only GET /orders 400 response path that is not documented in the BFF spec; coverage governance is enforced at the measured 92% coverage with maxMissedOperationsInSpec set to 1.

contractMappings.adapter: Forwards ProductBase JSON, adds Authenticate and Idempotency-Key for the backend contract, preserves Specmatic-Response-Code, and publishes the resulting product to Kafka when the backend returns 201.
Forwards type, from-date, to-date, and pageSize to the backend mock and returns the backend response body.
Forwards OrderBase JSON, adds Authenticate and Idempotency-Key for the backend contract, preserves Specmatic-Response-Code, and returns the backend response body.
Forwards orderId when present and returns the backend response body.
Synthesizes monitor status because this workflow is declared by the BFF contract.
Publishes a JSON product message with id, name, inventory, and categories to the Specmatic in-memory Kafka broker.
